pages.text: A dark, misty swamp whose glowing pools are real $(l:lumenwater)Lumenwater$(/l), fringed by glow algae and tall lumen reeds, with sparse $(l:glowroot_forest)Glowroot$(/l) rising from the wet ground.
The amphibious $(l:native_fauna)Mirelurker$(/l) lurks in the shallows and lunges at anyone who wades in — and it is faster after dark.
